Dev Workflow

📱 App
  • Branch off upstream/development
  • Make changes, commit
  • Open PR → development
  • Merge → CI builds APK (~10–15 min)
  • Install from kronk.info/dev/kronk.apk
🌐 Web + API
  • Branch off upstream/staging
  • Make changes, commit, push
  • Open draft PR → staging
  • Comment /deploy-staging on PR
  • Test at dev.mastodon.kronk.info
  • Mark ready → merge → production

Cross-Repo Features

App + Web changes? Build and merge the web/API side first — it needs to be live on staging before the app can test against it. Note in each PR which repo holds the other half.
